label: adl_bucket_triple_falsifier
pass_rule: status is pass only if n_finished>=100 and the lower Clopper-Pearson accuracy bound is >= 0.95 and the lower bootstrap bound of mean I is >= 0.92. Mean I is the locked designated-factor cosine-sum on trials that recovered factors, and only when every usable trial recovered. Otherwise mean I is null and the floors are not met. Small n is not a pass.

configuration.assumption: s is one component-wise product of three distinct codebook phasors
configuration.bucket_vector: linear sum of codewords, not phasor-projected
configuration.triple_enumeration: unordered distinct buckets; score is permutation-invariant
configuration.recovery: one exact scan, one codeword from each winning bucket, if winner I>=0.7 and a step remains
configuration.rehash: while winner I<0.7 and steps remain, the next step is an independent rehash
